upload.instructions:

wikiNotice.title: [XX-Before you import-XX]
wikiNotice.body: [XX-Read the <money>Importing from Microsoft Money</money> or <quicken>Importing from Quicken</quicken> section of the wiki before importing anything.-XX]

selectAccount.descriptionBulk: [XX-Verify or change the destination account for each file. Files have been automatically matched based on filename.-XX]
selectAccount.investmentFileNotice: [XX-This file contains investment transactions. Only brokerage accounts are shown.-XX]

csvMapping.heading: [XX-CSV Column Mapping-XX]
csvMapping.description: [XX-Map your CSV columns to transaction fields. Preview the data below and configure the mapping.-XX]
csvMapping.typeColumnDescription: [XX-Select the column that indicates income, expense, or transfer per row.-XX]
csvMapping.transferAccountColumnDesc: [XX-Column containing the transfer destination account name. Defaults to the Category column if not set.-XX]
csvMapping.tagsHelp: [XX-Multiple tags are auto-split on the detected separator (|, ;, or ,). Dashes and slashes are preserved as part of tag names.-XX]
csvMapping.reconciliationStatusHelp: [XX-Values like "cleared", "reconciled", "posted", "void", "*", or "X" are mapped automatically. Unknown values default to Unreconciled.-XX]
csvMapping.validationDebitCreditRequired: [XX-Both debit and credit columns are required-XX]
csvMapping.validationActionRequired: [XX-Action column is required for investment files-XX]
csvMapping.validationSecurityRequired: [XX-Security column is required for investment files-XX]
csvMapping.investmentModeHint: [XX-Rows are classified by the action column. Unmatched action values are imported as cash deposits or withdrawals on the linked cash account.-XX]
csvMapping.actionValuesUnmatched: [XX-Not matched (imported as cash by amount sign): {values}-XX]
csvMapping.actionKeywordsDescription: [XX-Comma-separated values matched exactly (case-insensitive) against the action column. A filled-in list replaces the defaults shown as placeholder for that action.-XX]

transferRules.title: [XX-Transfer Detection Rules-XX]
transferRules.description: [XX-Define patterns to identify transactions that are transfers between accounts. Matching is case-insensitive and uses "contains" logic.-XX]
transferRules.noRules: [XX-No transfer rules defined. Transfers will not be detected automatically.-XX]

mapCategories.heading: [XX-Map Categories-XX]
mapCategories.description: [XX-The following categories were found in your QIF file. Map them to existing categories or create new ones.-XX]
mapCategories.loanTransferNotice: [XX-Transactions with this category will be transferred to the selected loan account.-XX]

mapSecurities.heading: [XX-Map Securities-XX]
mapSecurities.description: [XX-The following securities were found in your QIF file. Map them to existing securities or create new ones.-XX]

mapAccounts.heading: [XX-Map Transfer Accounts-XX]
mapAccounts.description: [XX-The following transfer accounts were found in your QIF file. Map them to existing accounts or create new ones.-XX]

review.heading: [XX-Review Import-XX]
review.cashFallbackNotice: [XX-These action values were not recognized and will be imported as cash transactions: {values}-XX]
review.uncostedNotice: [XX-{count, plural, one {# purchase row has} other {# purchase rows have}} no price or amount and will be imported as added shares without cost.-XX]
review.rejectedNotice: [XX-{count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} cannot be imported:-XX]
review.rejectedGoBack: [XX-Go back to the column mapping step to adjust columns or action keywords.-XX]

complete.heading: [XX-Import Complete-XX]
complete.loanSetupDescription: [XX-The following loan/mortgage accounts were imported without scheduled payments. Set up recurring payments to continue tracking your loan progress.-XX]

multiAccountReview.heading: [XX-Multi-Account QIF Import-XX]
multiAccountReview.description: [XX-This file contains {accounts} account{accountsPlural}, {categories} categor{categoriesPlural}{tagsSection}, and {transactions} transaction{transactionsPlural}. Categories, accounts{tagsCreated} and transactions will be created automatically.-XX]
multiAccountReview.securitiesNotice: [XX-This file contains {count} securit{plural} that need to be mapped before import.-XX]

mnyPassword.heading: [XX-This Money file needs a password-XX]
mnyPassword.body: [XX-Microsoft Money encrypted this file with a password. Enter it to continue; it is used once to read the file and never stored.-XX]
mnyPassword.retryBody: [XX-That password did not open the file. Check it and try again -- Money passwords are case sensitive.-XX]
mnyPassword.label: [XX-Money file password-XX]

mnyReview.heading: [XX-Review your Microsoft Money file-XX]
mnyReview.fileSummary: [XX-{filename} -- {era}, base currency {currency}. Balances below are computed from the file itself, so you can check them against Money before importing.-XX]
mnyReview.missingTables: [XX-This Money version has no {tables} table, so anything it would have held is skipped.-XX]

options.referencedOnlyPayeesHint: [XX-Money keeps payees long after their last transaction. Leave this on to skip the unused ones.-XX]
options.referencedOnlyCategoriesHint: [XX-Money seeds a full category tree whether you use it or not. Leave this on to skip the categories you never touched.-XX]
options.importClosedAccountsHint: [XX-Closed accounts still hold history worth keeping. They are imported closed.-XX]
options.importPricesHint: [XX-Money's own record of what each security was worth, day by day. Turn this off if you would rather start from live quotes.-XX]
options.importExchangeRatesHint: [XX-Historical rates between the currencies in your file, used only for dates Monize has no rate for. Rates already stored are never replaced.-XX]
options.wipeExistingData: [XX-Start fresh: remove my existing Monize data first-XX]
options.wipeExistingDataHint: [XX-Runs the same Delete My Data operation as Settings before importing. You will be asked to confirm. Leave this off to add the Money file to what you already have.-XX]

mnyBills.heading: [XX-Scheduled bills to create ({count})-XX]
mnyBills.explainer: [XX-Money keeps a row for every occurrence of a bill, so a long history holds thousands of them. These are the series that still look active. Untick any you do not want — unticked bills are not created at all.-XX]
mnyBills.unsupported: [XX-This Money version predates scheduled bills, so there are none to import.-XX]
mnyBills.skipped: [XX-{count, plural, one {# bill series was} other {# bill series were}} missing a template or a usable date and cannot be imported.-XX]

mnyWipe.heading: [XX-Remove your existing data first?-XX]
mnyWipe.body: [XX-This runs the same Delete My Data operation as Settings -> Danger Zone, before the import begins. It removes:-XX]

removes.investments: [XX-Every security, price, holding and investment transaction-XX]
removes.budgets: [XX-Every budget, custom report, tag and import mapping-XX]

mnyWipe.irreversible: [XX-This cannot be undone. If the import then fails, the removed data does not come back.-XX]
mnyWipe.oidcNote: [XX-Your identity provider already confirmed this session, so no password is needed.-XX]

mnyImporting.heading: [XX-Importing your Money file-XX]
mnyImporting.doNotClose: [XX-This runs on the server, so you can leave this page and come back. A large file takes a few minutes.-XX]

mnyComplete.heading: [XX-Import finished-XX]
mnyComplete.allMatch: [XX-All {count} accounts reconcile: every balance matches the one computed from your Money file.-XX]
mnyComplete.someDiffer: [XX-{count} accounts do not match the balance computed from your Money file. The rows marked below show the difference.-XX]
mnyComplete.someHoldingsDiffer: [XX-Every balance reconciles, but {count, plural, one {# holding does} other {# holdings do}} not match the shares recorded in your Money file. The rows marked below show the difference.-XX]
mnyComplete.existingDataRemoved: [XX-Your existing data was removed before this import, as requested.-XX]
mnyComplete.holdingsExplainer: [XX-Shares Monize now holds, against the open tax lots your Money file records. Money reconciles against those lots itself, so they are the number to trust.-XX]

mnyWarnings.missingTable: [XX-This Money version has no {count, plural, one {# table} other {# tables}} the import uses.-XX]
mnyWarnings.missingField: [XX-{count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}} were not in this Money version and took a default.-XX]
mnyWarnings.unknownAccountType: [XX-{count, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}} had an account type Monize does not recognize and were skipped.-XX]
mnyWarnings.duplicateAccountName: [XX-{count, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}} shared a name with another and were renamed.-XX]
mnyWarnings.unknownCurrency: [XX-{count, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}} referenced a currency the file does not define, and use the base currency.-XX]
mnyWarnings.categoryFlattened: [XX-{count, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}} were deeper than two levels and were flattened into their parent.-XX]
mnyWarnings.categoryTypeInferred: [XX-Money's income flag was missing for {count, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}}; income or expense came from the category tree.-XX]
mnyWarnings.degeneratePayeeSkipped: [XX-{count, plural, one {# placeholder payee} other {# placeholder payees}} Money keeps internally were skipped.-XX]
mnyWarnings.unusableTransaction: [XX-{count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}} had no account or no usable date and were skipped.-XX]
mnyWarnings.orphanedTransferSide: [XX-{count, plural, one {# transfer} other {# transfers}} were missing their other side in the file and were skipped.-XX]
mnyWarnings.orphanedSplit: [XX-{count, plural, one {# split leg} other {# split legs}} had no parent transaction and were skipped.-XX]
mnyWarnings.splitSumMismatch: [XX-{count, plural, one {# split} other {# splits}} had legs that do not add up to the transaction total; Money's own totals were kept.-XX]
mnyWarnings.transferAcrossExcludedAccount: [XX-{count, plural, one {# transfer} other {# transfers}} pointed at an account you left out and were imported as ordinary transactions.-XX]
mnyWarnings.balanceMismatch: [XX-{count, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}} ended with a balance that differs from the Money file.-XX]
mnyWarnings.duplicateSecuritySymbol: [XX-{count, plural, one {# security shares} other {# securities share}} a symbol with another; the later ones were renamed so they stay separate.-XX]
mnyWarnings.generatedSecuritySymbol: [XX-{count, plural, one {# security has} other {# securities have}} no symbol in Money, so a placeholder was generated and price updates left off.-XX]
mnyWarnings.unknownInvestmentAction: [XX-{count, plural, one {# investment transaction} other {# investment transactions}} used an action Monize does not recognize and were skipped.-XX]
mnyWarnings.unconfirmedInvestmentAction: [XX-{count, plural, one {# investment transaction} other {# investment transactions}} used a Money action whose meaning is inferred rather than documented; check them against Money.-XX]
mnyWarnings.missingInvestmentDetail: [XX-{count, plural, one {# investment transaction} other {# investment transactions}} had no share detail in the file and were imported for their cash amount only.-XX]
mnyWarnings.investmentAccountMismatch: [XX-{count, plural, one {# investment transaction} other {# investment transactions}} sat in an account that is not an investment account and were skipped.-XX]
mnyWarnings.securitySplitNotApplied: [XX-{count, plural, one {# stock split is recorded in the file and was not applied to share counts, because Money does not apply it either} other {# stock splits are recorded in the file and were not applied to share counts, because Money does not apply them either}}. Check the holdings against your statements.-XX]
mnyWarnings.holdingsMismatch: [XX-{count, plural, one {# holding does} other {# holdings do}} not match the shares your Money file records.-XX]
mnyWarnings.billTemplateMissing: [XX-{count, plural, one {# scheduled bill} other {# scheduled bills}} had no template transaction in the file and were skipped.-XX]
mnyWarnings.unusableBill: [XX-{count, plural, one {# scheduled bill} other {# scheduled bills}} had no account, no usable date or an unrecognized recurrence, and were skipped.-XX]
mnyWarnings.billFrequencyApproximated: [XX-{count, plural, one {# scheduled bill uses} other {# scheduled bills use}} a repeat interval Monize cannot express exactly, so the closest shorter one was used.-XX]
mnyWarnings.loanInterestCategoryUnclear: [XX-{count, plural, one {# loan payment} other {# loan payments}} included multiple non-principal categories, so the loan's interest category was left unset. Check whether the payment includes escrow and set the interest category after import.-XX]
mnyWarnings.reviewInMoney: [XX-Open these in Microsoft Money to check or correct them, then export and import again.-XX]
mnyWarnings.reviewInMoneyTruncated: [XX-Showing the first {shown} of {total}. Open these in Microsoft Money to check or correct them, then export and import again.-XX]

mnyErrors.mnyImportFailed: [XX-Something went wrong while importing. Nothing was saved -- you can try again.-XX]
mnyErrors.mnyJobStalled: [XX-The import stopped responding, most likely because the server restarted. Your uploaded file is still here, so trying again is safe.-XX]
mnyErrors.mnyJobStalledAfterCommit: [XX-The import stopped responding after it had already saved your data, most likely because the server restarted. The imported records are in your account, so importing the same file again would duplicate them. Check your accounts before importing anything else.-XX]
mnyErrors.mnyStagedFileMissing: [XX-The uploaded Money file is no longer available. Please upload it again.-XX]
mnyErrors.mnyFileTruncated: [XX-That Money file looks incomplete. The upload may have been interrupted.-XX]
mnyErrors.mnyNotAMoneyFile: [XX-That file is not a Microsoft Money (.mny) file.-XX]
mnyErrors.mnyUnsupportedVersion: [XX-That file was written by Money 97 or 98. Open and save it once in the free Money Plus Sunset edition, then import the result.-XX]
mnyErrors.mnyPasswordIncorrect: [XX-That password does not open the Money file.-XX]
mnyErrors.mnyUnreadableDatabase: [XX-That Money file was decrypted but its contents could not be read. It may be damaged.-XX]
